title: Add character timeline conflict-resolution UX
description:
Build the user-facing conflict-resolution layer on top of the character custody lifecycle from eshyra-lupf.14.3. When a campaign resumes with a registry-linked character whose registry head has advanced elsewhere, do not silently overwrite, steal custody, or revert history. Present explicit choices: cancel, catch this campaign up to the latest registry revision, or intentionally branch/fork into an alternate timeline. Define and document the more advanced 'future detour' case as out-of-order narrative continuity with manual mechanical reconciliation, not automatic timeline merging.

This bead is the parent/epic; the tractable work is split across children eshyra-lupf.14.4.1 (policy design), .2 (catch-up-to-head CLI), .3 (continuity-bridge narration), .4 (explicit fork CLI), and .5 (future-detour design-only). The earlier 14.3 follow-up scope (CLI fork + non-head checkout revision) is folded into .4 / .2.
acceptance_criteria:
- Resume conflicts are surfaced as user choices rather than only raw custody errors.
- Catch-up-to-head is supported as the primary happy path.
- Fork/alternate timeline is explicit and clearly warns that continuity breaks.
- Future-detour semantics are documented, including limitations and consequences.
- No implementation path silently merges or rewrites character timelines.
- Mid-scene/combat catch-up requires an explicit warning or confirmation.
- ADR 0012 or a follow-up design doc records the policy.
